column5: vtable pointer at +0 of every object: every class stamps its vtable at +0 of the receiver (docs/engine/rtti-and-vtables.md; config/SLUS-20836/receiver-classes.tsv `vtable-stamp`)

reference-count word at +4: low 23 bits count, high 9 bits flags; release idiom `--o->refs; if ((refs & 0x7fffff) == 0) igObject_Destroy(o)` at hundreds of matched sites, the matched igObject_Destroy (0x002ff820) that the idiom calls at zero, and igObject_InitHeader (0x002fef20) which stores the count 1 / flag 0 / top byte 0 through the shim `{vt; unsigned refs:23; unsigned flag:1; unsigned char b7}`; the identifier `_refCount` is by convention of the engine family (a name hypothesis, the layout is measured)

CRI ADXF file handle at +96, inside the 104-byte registered instance after the last reflected field (_lSleepTime +88): the open slot (0x00333a60) stores the handle the ADXF open-by-name (0x002618c0) or open-AFS-entry (0x00261b78) call returns and tests it for failure; slots 22, 24, 25, 36 and 37 and the status and size helpers pass it as the first argument of ADXF close (0x00261c88), read (0x002620d8), seek (0x002623f8), tell (0x00262510), size (0x00262540) and status (0x00262678); slot 11 clears it. CRI's own messages name that parameter `adxf` ("'adxf' is NULL.(ADXF_Tell)")
